questions.q: The diagonal of a rectangle is 25 cm and one side is 24 cm. Find its area.
questions.why: Other side √(625 − 576) = 7; area 24 × 7 = 168. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: Geeta is the mother of Kavita. Kavita is the sister of Deepak. Deepak is the father of Sita. How is Geeta related to Sita?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Grandmother. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: Some pens are books. No books are bags. Conclusions: I. No pens are bags. II. No bags are pens.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II need not be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 51, 56, 61, 63, 71, 76, 81
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 5, so 63 should be 66. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 5, 8, 14, 26, 50, …
questions.why: Each term is ×2 − 2. Next: 98. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word TABLET be arranged?
questions.why: 6 letters with repeats: 6! ÷ 2! = 360. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Neha walks 6 m North, then turns left and walks 7 m, then turns right and walks 9 m. Which direction is Neha facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the North. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Ajay is the son of Sita. Rahul is the daughter of Sita. Meera is the husband of Rahul. How is Meera related to Ajay?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 582, 605, 588, 611, 634, 617, 600
questions.why: The pattern is +23, −17 by turns: 611 − 17 = 594, not 634. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2026.

questions.q: If 10 March 2022 was a Thursday, what day of the week was 11 June 2022?
questions.why: 93 days later; 93 mod 7 = 2, so count 2 days on from Thursday. GPSC-style practice item.
